text: 花谢花飞花满天，红消香断有谁怜
pinyin: huā xiè huā fēi huā mǎn tiān, hóng xiāo xiāng duàn yǒu shéi lián
literal: flowers · wither · flowers · fly · flowers · fill · sky, red · fade · fragrance · end · who · pities
natural: blossoms fade and fly until they fill the sky; when the colour is gone and the scent has ended, who will pity them

meaning.en: The opening of Daiyu's Burying-the-Flowers lament: fallen petals fill the sky, and no one pities them once their beauty has gone, a figure for her own fragile fate.
meaning.zh: 《红楼梦》中林黛玉《葬花吟》的开头：花落满天，红消香断，无人怜惜，暗喻自己身世飘零。

equivalents: no one mourns the fallen blossom
fading beauty, none to pity it

examples.zh: 读到花谢花飞花满天，红消香断有谁怜，她不禁想起黛玉葬花的场景。
examples.en: Reading 'petals fade and fly, who pities the faded bloom', she thought of Daiyu burying the flowers.

examples.zh: 春末落花满地，同学们不约而同地念起“花谢花飞花满天，红消香断有谁怜”。
examples.en: At the end of spring, with petals all over the ground, the students found themselves reciting 'petals fade and fly, who pities the faded bloom'.

origin.source: 曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回《葬花吟》

story.en: In chapter 27 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (《红楼梦》) by Cao Xueqin (c.1715-1763) the heroine Lin Daiyu buries fallen petals and sings this long lament, 《葬花吟》.
story.zh: 《红楼梦》（曹雪芹，约1715—1763）第二十七回，林黛玉在园中葬花，吟出这首长歌《葬花吟》。

usage.en: Quoted when petals fall in late spring or to express wistfulness at passing beauty. Literary; the first couplet of the 《葬花吟》 sung by Lin Daiyu in chapter 27 of the novel.
usage.zh: 常在暮春落花时节或感叹美好事物凋零时引用。文学色彩浓，是《红楼梦》第二十七回林黛玉所吟《葬花吟》的首联。

text: 侬今葬花人笑痴，他年葬侬知是谁
pinyin: nóng jīn zàng huā rén xiào chī, tā nián zàng nóng zhī shì shéi
literal: I · now · bury · flowers · people · laugh · foolish, some · year · bury · me · know · is · who
natural: today I bury the flowers and people laugh at my folly; who will bury me in years to come, who knows

meaning.en: Daiyu's lament: people laugh at her for burying flowers, but she wonders who will one day bury her.
meaning.zh: 林黛玉的感叹：世人笑我葬花痴傻，可将来谁来埋葬我呢？写尽孤独与对命运的忧惧。

equivalents: who will bury me when my turn comes
who will mourn me when I am gone

examples.zh: 侬今葬花人笑痴，他年葬侬知是谁，这两句读来令人心酸。
examples.en: The couplet 'they laugh at me burying flowers; who will bury me?' is heartbreaking to read.

examples.zh: 话剧里黛玉念到“侬今葬花人笑痴，他年葬侬知是谁”，全场安静了下来。
examples.en: When Daiyu recited 'they laugh at me burying flowers; who will bury me?' the theatre fell silent.

origin.source: 曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回《葬花吟》

story.en: A couplet from the 《葬花吟》 that Lin Daiyu sings in chapter 27 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' as she buries the fallen petals.
story.zh: 出自《红楼梦》第二十七回林黛玉所吟《葬花吟》。

usage.en: Quoted for loneliness and fear of an unmourned fate, or in discussions of the novel. 侬 is a Wu-dialect word for 'I'. Literary.
usage.zh: 多用来表达孤独与对身后命运的忧惧，或谈论《红楼梦》时引用。“侬”是吴方言中的“我”。文学色彩浓。

text: 都道是金玉良缘，俺只念木石前盟
pinyin: dōu dào shì jīn yù liáng yuán, ǎn zhǐ niàn mù shí qián méng
literal: all · say · is · gold · jade · good · match, I · only · cherish · wood · stone · former · pledge
natural: everyone calls it the golden match of gold and jade, but I cherish only the old pledge of wood and stone

meaning.en: From the song 'A Life Misled': everyone praises the 'gold and jade' marriage, but the hero's heart stays with the earlier bond of 'wood and stone' (Daiyu).
meaning.zh: 出自《红楼梦曲·终身误》：世人都称道宝钗与宝玉的“金玉良缘”，宝玉心里却只记得与黛玉的“木石前盟”。

equivalents: everyone praises the match, yet his heart holds to an older vow
the marriage the world applauds versus the love he cherishes

examples.zh: “都道是金玉良缘，俺只念木石前盟”，说的就是宝玉的两难。
examples.en: 'Everyone calls it a golden match, I only cherish the old pledge' sums up Baoyu's dilemma.

examples.zh: 论文讨论了“都道是金玉良缘，俺只念木石前盟”一句中的对照手法。
examples.en: The essay discusses the contrast in the line 'everyone calls it a golden match, I only cherish the old pledge'.

origin.source: 曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回《红楼梦曲·终身误》

story.en: In chapter 5 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Baoyu hears twelve songs in the Land of Illusion that foretell the fates of the heroines; 《终身误》 is the song about Baochai.
story.zh: 《红楼梦》第五回，贾宝玉在太虚幻境中听到预示众女子命运的十二支曲子，《终身误》是其中咏宝钗的一支。

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of the novel and of marriage against true feeling. 金玉 stands for Baochai (her gold locket) and Baoyu (his jade), 木石 for Daiyu (a plant) and Baoyu (a stone). 金玉良缘 and 木石前盟 are also entries on their own.
usage.zh: 谈论《红楼梦》或婚姻与真情的矛盾时引用。“金玉”指宝钗的金锁与宝玉的通灵玉，“木石”指黛玉（绛珠草）与宝玉（神瑛）。“金玉良缘”“木石前盟”本身也各有词条。

text: 一个是水中月，一个是镜中花
pinyin: yī gè shì shuǐ zhōng yuè, yī gè shì jìng zhōng huā
literal: one · is · water · in · moon, one · is · mirror · in · flower
natural: one is a moon in the water, the other a flower in a mirror

meaning.en: From the song 'Knitted Brows': a love as unreachable as the moon's reflection or a flower in a mirror, seen but never held.
meaning.zh: 出自《红楼梦曲·枉凝眉》：两个人的情缘如水中之月、镜中之花，看得见却得不到。

equivalents: a mirage that cannot be grasped
moon in the water, flower in the mirror

examples.zh: 他们两地相隔，这段感情终究是一个是水中月，一个是镜中花，看得见却摸不着。
examples.en: Living far apart, their love was in the end "one the moon in the water, one the flower in the mirror": visible but never to be held.

examples.zh: 读到“一个是水中月，一个是镜中花”，不少读者为宝黛的结局叹息。
examples.en: Many readers sigh over Baoyu and Daiyu's fate on reading 'one a moon in the water, one a flower in the mirror'.

origin.source: 曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回《红楼梦曲·枉凝眉》

story.en: Part of the song 《枉凝眉》 in chapter 5 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber', which foretells the doomed love of Baoyu and Daiyu.
story.zh: 出自《红楼梦》第五回的曲子《枉凝眉》，预示宝玉与黛玉的爱情悲剧。

usage.en: The line is quoted of any hope that proves illusory; the pair 水中月 and 镜中花 is also used on its own. Literary.
usage.zh: 常用来形容虚幻、无法实现的愿望；“水中月”“镜中花”也可单独使用。文学色彩浓。

text: 世人都晓神仙好，惟有功名忘不了
pinyin: shì rén dōu xiǎo shén xiān hǎo, wéi yǒu gōng míng wàng bù liǎo
literal: worldly · people · all · know · immortals · good, only · have · fame · rank · forget · cannot
natural: everyone knows it is good to be an immortal, yet no one can forget fame and rank

meaning.en: The first line of the 'Song of Good-and-Done': people praise a life free of worldly ties but cannot let go of fame and office.
meaning.zh: 《好了歌》开头：世人都知道超脱尘世的神仙生活好，却放不下功名利禄。

equivalents: everyone praises detachment but chases status
the lure of fame never lets go

examples.zh: 世人都晓神仙好，惟有功名忘不了，他跳槽只为更高的头衔。
examples.en: 'All praise the immortal life, but none forget fame': he only changed jobs for a grander title.

examples.zh: 老教授引用“世人都晓神仙好，惟有功名忘不了”，劝学生淡泊名利。
examples.en: The old professor quoted 'all praise the immortal life but none forget fame' to urge his students towards modesty.

origin.source: 曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一回《好了歌》

story.en: In chapter 1 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' a lame Daoist sings the 《好了歌》 to the scholar Zhen Shiyin, warning that fame, wealth and family all pass.
story.zh: 《红楼梦》第一回，跛足道人向甄士隐唱《好了歌》，说明功名、金银、家人终归虚空。

usage.en: Often quoted with a wry smile about those who preach detachment but chase status. The song continues with the same refrain for wealth, wives and children. 惟 is also written 唯.
usage.zh: 常带着调侃，形容嘴上说淡泊、心里却放不下名利的人。《好了歌》接着以同样的句式写金银、娇妻、儿孙。“惟”也写作“唯”。

variants: 世人都晓神仙好，唯有功名忘不了

text: 衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声
pinyin: yá zhāi wò tīng xiāo xiāo zhú, yí shì mín jiān jí kǔ shēng
literal: yamen · study · lie · hear · rustling · bamboo, suspect · is · people · among · hardship · sound
natural: lying in my office I hear the bamboo rustle and take it for the sound of the people's suffering

meaning.en: A conscientious official, hearing bamboo rustle outside his study, thinks of the hardships of the common people.
meaning.zh: 清官躺在衙署书斋里听到竹叶萧萧作响，疑心是百姓疾苦的声音：形容官员时刻关心民间疾苦。

equivalents: the ear of a caring official
to hear the people's troubles in the wind

examples.zh: 他把“衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声”挂在办公室里自勉。
examples.en: He hung 'in my office I hear the bamboo, and fancy the people's cries' on his wall as a reminder.

examples.zh: 县领导引用“衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声”，要求干部多下基层。
examples.en: The county head quoted 'I hear the bamboo and fancy the people's cries' to ask officials to spend more time at the grassroots.

origin.source: 郑板桥《潍县署中画竹呈年伯包大中丞括》

story.en: Zheng Banqiao (Zheng Xie, 1693-1765), magistrate of Weixian in Shandong, wrote this poem on a bamboo painting for his superior Bao Kuo; he was known for caring about famine relief.
story.zh: 郑板桥（郑燮，1693—1765）任山东潍县知县时，在一幅墨竹上题此诗赠上司包括，他以赈济灾民著称。

usage.en: Quoted in official or moral contexts to praise officials who care about the public. The poem ends 些小吾曹州县吏，一枝一叶总关情. Formal, positive.
usage.zh: 常在公务场合引用，称赞心系百姓的官员。全诗末两句是“些小吾曹州县吏，一枝一叶总关情”。正式，褒义。

text: 删繁就简三秋树，领异标新二月花
pinyin: shān fán jiù jiǎn sān qiū shù, lǐng yì biāo xīn èr yuè huā
literal: cut · profusion · approach · simplicity · third · autumn · tree, lead · difference · set · new · second · month · flower
natural: pare down to simplicity like a tree in late autumn; strike out in new ways like flowers in the second month

meaning.en: A couplet on art and writing: strip away the superfluous like a bare autumn tree, and be original like early-spring blossom.
meaning.zh: 谈艺术与写作的名联：去掉繁冗，像秋天的疏枝；标举新意，像二月的鲜花。

equivalents: less is more, and be original
pare down and strike out anew

examples.zh: 老编辑常说“删繁就简三秋树，领异标新二月花”，这是改稿的两条准绳。
examples.en: The old editor often said 'pare down like the autumn tree, be original like the spring flower': two rules for revision.

examples.zh: 画室的墙上写着“删繁就简三秋树，领异标新二月花”。
examples.en: On the studio wall is written 'pare down like the autumn tree, be original like the spring flower'.

story.en: The couplet is traditionally credited to Zheng Banqiao (1693-1765) as a self-written couplet on his studio, but the attribution rests on tradition rather than a securely dated text.
story.zh: 此联相传是郑板桥（1693—1765）的自题联，但出处靠传说，并无可靠的早期文本。

usage.en: A favourite for studios and writing classes. Attribution to Zheng Banqiao is traditional rather than firmly documented. 删繁就简 also stands alone as an entry.
usage.zh: 常用作书画室、写作课的题词。把此联归于郑板桥是相传之说，并无确凿文献。“删繁就简”本身另有词条。

text: 新竹高于旧竹枝，全凭老干为扶持
pinyin: xīn zhú gāo yú jiù zhú zhī, quán píng lǎo gàn wéi fú chí
literal: new · bamboo · taller · than · old · bamboo · branch, wholly · rely · old · trunk · as · support
natural: the new bamboo stands taller than the old shoots, yet it owes all to the old stems that support it

meaning.en: Young bamboo overtops the old, but only because the old stalks nurtured it: the young surpass their elders by standing on their shoulders.
meaning.zh: 新竹长得比旧竹高，全靠老竹的扶持：比喻后辈超过前辈，离不开前辈的培养。

equivalents: standing on the shoulders of giants
the young surpass the old thanks to the old

examples.zh: 新竹高于旧竹枝，全凭老干为扶持，毕业典礼上校长这样感谢老教师。
examples.en: 'The new bamboo stands higher, held up by the old stalks': so the head thanked the veteran teachers at the graduation ceremony.

examples.zh: 他引用“新竹高于旧竹枝，全凭老干为扶持”，感谢师父的栽培。
examples.en: He quoted 'the new bamboo outgrows the old, held up by the old stalks' to thank his master.

story.en: From Zheng Banqiao's poem 《新竹》 ('New Bamboo'); he painted and wrote about bamboo throughout his career.
story.zh: 出自郑板桥的《新竹》诗；他一生画竹、咏竹。

usage.en: Used to thank teachers and mentors, or to speak of passing the torch. The poem goes on 明年再有新生者，十丈龙孙绕凤池.
usage.zh: 常用于感谢师长前辈、谈薪火相传。全诗后两句为“明年再有新生者，十丈龙孙绕凤池”。

text: 白日不到处，青春恰自来；苔花如米小，也学牡丹开
pinyin: bái rì bù dào chù, qīng chūn qià zì lái, tái huā rú mǐ xiǎo, yě xué mǔ dān kāi
literal: bright · sun · not · reach · place, youth · just · of itself · come, moss · flower · like · rice · small, also · learn · peony · bloom
natural: where the sun never reaches, spring still comes of itself; the moss flower, small as a grain of rice, blooms like a peony all the same

meaning.en: Even the tiniest moss flower in a sunless spot blooms with all its might: small, unnoticed lives can still flower.
meaning.zh: 阳光照不到的角落，青春依然到来；米粒大的苔花，也像牡丹那样开放：比喻平凡渺小者同样能绽放生命的光彩。

equivalents: bloom where you are planted
even the smallest flower has its spring

examples.zh: 山区孩子合唱团唱起“白日不到处，青春恰自来；苔花如米小，也学牡丹开”，感动了很多人。
examples.en: A children's choir from the mountains sang 'where the sun never reaches, spring still comes; small as rice, the moss flower blooms like a peony', and moved many.

examples.zh: 白日不到处，青春恰自来；苔花如米小，也学牡丹开，这首小诗鼓励了无数普通人。
examples.en: 'Where the sun does not reach, spring still comes; small as rice, the moss flower blooms like a peony': this little poem has encouraged countless ordinary people.

story.en: A four-line poem 《苔》 ('Moss') by Yuan Mei, the Qing poet and essayist, found in his collected poems.
story.zh: 清代诗人、散文家袁枚的四句小诗《苔》，见于其诗集。

usage.en: Became widely known after a 2019 televised performance and is now often quoted to encourage ordinary people and rural children. The poem is by Yuan Mei (1716-1798), the Qing poet.
usage.zh: 因2019年一档电视节目而广为人知，如今常用来鼓励普通人和乡村孩子。作者是清代诗人袁枚（1716—1798）。

text: 李杜诗篇万口传，至今已觉不新鲜
pinyin: lǐ dù shī piān wàn kǒu chuán, zhì jīn yǐ jué bù xīn xiān
literal: Li · Du · poems · ten thousand · mouths · pass on, until · now · already · feel · not · fresh
natural: the poems of Li and Du are on ten thousand lips; by now they no longer seem fresh

meaning.en: Zhao Yi's famous remark: even the poems of Li Bai and Du Fu, recited by everyone, have lost their novelty, so every age needs its own new talents.
meaning.zh: 赵翼的名句：李白、杜甫的诗人人传诵，如今已不觉新鲜，每个时代都应有自己的新创造。

equivalents: even the classics grow stale; every age needs new voices
yesterday's masterpieces are today's commonplaces

examples.zh: 评论家引用“李杜诗篇万口传，至今已觉不新鲜”，呼吁当代诗人写出新意。
examples.en: The critic quoted 'Li and Du are on every lip, yet no longer fresh' to call on contemporary poets for originality.

examples.zh: 李杜诗篇万口传，至今已觉不新鲜，这话听起来狂，其实是在讲创新。
examples.en: 'Li and Du are on every lip, yet no longer fresh' sounds bold, but it is really about innovation.

story.en: Zhao Yi (1727-1814), a Qing historian and poet, wrote five poems on poetry; this is the second, whose next line is 江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年.
story.zh: 清代史学家、诗人赵翼（1727—1814）作《论诗五首》，此为其二，下句为“江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年”。

usage.en: The next line is 江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年, which is often quoted together (see that entry). Zhao Yi (1727-1814) does not belittle Li and Du: the point is that poetry must renew itself.
usage.zh: 下一句是“江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年”，二句常连用（见该词条）。赵翼（1727—1814）并非贬低李杜，而是主张诗歌要不断创新。

text: 海到无边天作岸，山登绝顶我为峰
pinyin: hǎi dào wú biān tiān zuò àn, shān dēng jué dǐng wǒ wéi fēng
literal: sea · reach · no · edge · sky · as · shore, mountain · climb · utmost · summit · I · be · peak
natural: where the sea has no edge, the sky is its shore; climbing a mountain to its summit, I myself am the peak

meaning.en: A couplet of lofty ambition: the sea's shore is the sky, and the climber who reaches the top becomes the summit.
meaning.zh: 志向高远的联语：大海无边，以天为岸；登上山顶，自己就是最高峰。

equivalents: the sky is the limit
aim for the summit and become the peak

examples.zh: 毕业赠言里，校长写下“海到无边天作岸，山登绝顶我为峰”。
examples.en: In the graduation message the head wrote 'the sky is the shore of a boundless sea; at the summit I am the peak'.

examples.zh: 他把“海到无边天作岸，山登绝顶我为峰”当作座右铭。
examples.en: He took 'the sky is the shore of a boundless sea; at the summit I am the peak' as his motto.

usage.en: Often quoted as a motto of ambition. It is traditionally credited to Lin Zexu (1785-1850) as a couplet he wrote, but the attribution is not firmly documented, so no source is given; his better-attested couplet is 海纳百川，有容乃大.
usage.zh: 常作志向高远的座右铭。相传为林则徐（1785—1850）所题联，但无可靠文献，故不标出处；其有确切出处的联语是“海纳百川，有容乃大”。

text: 浩荡离愁白日斜，吟鞭东指即天涯
pinyin: hào dàng lí chóu bái rì xié, yín biān dōng zhǐ jí tiān yá
literal: vast · parting · sorrow · bright · sun · slanting, chanting · whip · east · point · is · world's end
natural: parting sorrow vast beneath the slanting sun; my riding whip points east, and that is the ends of the earth

meaning.en: Gong Zizhen leaves Beijing in 1839: boundless sorrow of parting under a setting sun, the whip pointing eastward to a distant road.
meaning.zh: 龚自珍离京南归时所作：离愁浩荡，夕阳西斜，扬鞭东指，前路遥远如天涯。

equivalents: parting sorrow vast as the setting sun
riding off towards the edge of the world

examples.zh: 毕业离校那天，他心里正是“浩荡离愁白日斜，吟鞭东指即天涯”。
examples.en: On the day he left school he felt exactly 'vast parting sorrow beneath the slanting sun'.

examples.zh: 浩荡离愁白日斜，吟鞭东指即天涯，诗人辞官南归时的心境跃然纸上。
examples.en: 'Vast parting sorrow beneath the slanting sun, my whip pointing east to the ends of the earth' conveys the poet's mood on resigning and heading south.

story.en: Gong Zizhen (1792-1841) left office in Beijing in 1839 (the 己亥 year) and wrote 315 poems on the journey south and back, the 《己亥杂诗》; this is the fifth.
story.zh: 龚自珍（1792—1841）己亥年（1839）辞官离京，南下途中作诗三百一十五首，合称《己亥杂诗》，此为其五。

usage.en: Quoted for farewells and departures. The poem continues with the famous 落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花. Literary.
usage.zh: 多用于送别、远行。下两句是名句“落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花”。文学色彩浓。

text: 但开风气不为师
pinyin: dàn kāi fēng qì bù wéi shī
literal: only · open · trend · not · be · teacher
natural: only open up a new trend, without setting oneself up as a master

meaning.en: Be a pioneer who starts a new trend, but do not claim the title of master or demand disciples.
meaning.zh: 只愿开创风气，而不以宗师自居：形容开拓者的谦逊与气度。

equivalents: to pioneer without posing as the master
blaze a trail, take no credit

examples.zh: 他在业界开了先河，却始终奉行“但开风气不为师”。
examples.en: He pioneered the field, yet always followed the rule 'open the way, but do not play the master'.

examples.zh: 但开风气不为师，这位老学者从不收门徒。
examples.en: 'Open the way but do not play the master': the old scholar never took disciples.

story.en: From Gong Zizhen's 《己亥杂诗》 (1839), in a poem whose couplet says that a great literary master is here today who sets new trends without claiming to be a teacher.
story.zh: 出自龚自珍《己亥杂诗》（1839），诗中说当今有一位文宗，开创风气而不以师自居。

usage.en: Often used in praise of a pioneer. The full couplet is 一代文宗今日在，但开风气不为师. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 多用来称赞开创者的谦逊。完整的联句是“一代文宗今日在，但开风气不为师”。正面，书面。

text: 避席畏闻文字狱，著书都为稻粱谋
pinyin: bì xí wèi wén wén zì yù, zhù shū dōu wèi dào liáng móu
literal: leave · mat · fear · hear · written · word · prison, write · book · all · for · rice · millet · scheme
natural: we leave the table at the mere mention of literary inquisitions; all our books are written merely to earn our daily grain

meaning.en: Gong Zizhen on the Qing literary inquisitions: scholars shun dangerous talk and write only to make a living.
meaning.zh: 龚自珍讽刺清代文字狱：文人怕惹祸，躲避议论时事，著书只为谋生。

equivalents: writing for a living, never for the truth
scholars silenced by censorship

examples.zh: 他引用“避席畏闻文字狱，著书都为稻粱谋”，批评学界只求发表数量。
examples.en: He quoted 'we flee talk of literary inquisitions and write only for our daily grain' to criticise academia's obsession with output.

examples.zh: 避席畏闻文字狱，著书都为稻粱谋，写出了清代文人的无奈。
examples.en: 'Fleeing talk of literary inquisitions, writing only for our grain' captures the helplessness of Qing literati.

story.en: Gong Zizhen's 《咏史》 ('On History') laments that the Qing literary inquisitions of the 18th century cowed scholars; the poem opens 金粉东南十五州.
story.zh: 龚自珍《咏史》诗感叹清代文字狱使文人噤声，全诗开头为“金粉东南十五州”。

usage.en: Today often used wryly of people who write for pay or career rather than conviction. 稻粱谋 'scheming for rice and millet' means making a living.
usage.zh: 今天常带讽刺，指为稻粱谋生而不为信念写作的人。“稻粱谋”指谋生。

text: 欲灭其国，必先去其史
pinyin: yù miè qí guó, bì xiān qù qí shǐ
literal: wish · destroy · its · state · must · first · remove · its · history
natural: to destroy a nation, first erase its history

meaning.en: A people's history is the root of its identity, so anyone who wants to destroy a state begins by wiping out its past.
meaning.zh: 一个民族的历史是其认同的根基，想要灭亡一个国家，必先抹去它的历史。

equivalents: to destroy a people, erase its history
a nation without memory is easily conquered

examples.zh: 老师引用“欲灭其国，必先去其史”，强调历史教育的重要。
examples.en: The teacher quoted 'to destroy a nation, first erase its history' to stress history education.

examples.zh: 欲灭其国，必先去其史，这句话常被用来警惕历史虚无主义。
examples.en: 'To destroy a nation, first erase its history' is often cited as a warning against historical nihilism.

story.en: In his essay 《古史钩沉论二》 Gong Zizhen (1792-1841) writes that to destroy another's state, to ruin its institutions, to cut off its talent, to uproot its ancestors, one must first remove its history; the saying is a condensed form of the first of these clauses.
story.zh: 龚自珍（1792—1841）在《古史钩沉论二》中写道：要灭人之国、败人之纲纪、绝人之材、夷人之祖宗，必先去其史；此语是首句的缩略形式。

usage.en: This popular form is a paraphrase; Gong Zizhen's own wording is 灭人之国，必先去其史, which belongs to a longer run of parallel clauses. Commonly cited in debates on history teaching and memory.
usage.zh: 这是流行的简略说法；龚自珍原文作“灭人之国，必先去其史”，在一连串排比句之中。常见于讨论历史教育与历史记忆的场合。

text: 译事三难：信、达、雅
pinyin: yì shì sān nán, xìn, dá, yǎ
literal: translation · matter · three · difficulties: faithful, fluent, elegant
natural: translation has three difficulties: fidelity, fluency and elegance

meaning.en: Yan Fu's classic statement of the three standards of translation: be faithful to the original, make it clear and fluent, and write it elegantly.
meaning.zh: 严复提出的翻译三原则：忠实原文，表达通顺明白，文辞优雅。

equivalents: faithfulness, expressiveness and elegance
the three demands of translation

examples.zh: 翻译课上，老师先讲“译事三难：信、达、雅”。
examples.en: In the translation class the teacher started with 'translation has three difficulties: faithfulness, fluency, elegance'.

examples.zh: 译事三难：信、达、雅，至今仍是许多译者的准绳。
examples.en: 'Translation has three difficulties: fidelity, fluency, elegance' remains a yardstick for many translators.

story.en: Yan Fu (1854-1921) opened the 'Translator's Preface' to his 1898 version of Huxley's 'Evolution and Ethics' (《天演论》) with 'translation has three difficulties: fidelity, fluency, elegance'.
story.zh: 严复（1854—1921）在1898年所译赫胥黎《天演论》的《译例言》开头写道：“译事三难：信、达、雅。”

usage.en: The standard reference in Chinese translation studies; later scholars debate whether 雅 (a classical style) still applies. Yan Fu wrote 信达雅 as three single characters, so 信达雅 is also quoted on its own.
usage.zh: 中国翻译学的基本参照；后人对“雅”（古雅文体）是否仍适用有不少争论。“信达雅”三字也常单独引用。

text: 一名之立，旬月踟蹰
pinyin: yī míng zhī lì, xún yuè chí chú
literal: one · term · 's · establishing, ten days · month · hesitate
natural: to fix a single term, I may hesitate for ten days or a month

meaning.en: Yan Fu on the pains of translating: settling on one term can mean weeks of hesitation. It stands for painstaking care over words.
meaning.zh: 严复谈翻译之难：确定一个译名，要犹豫斟酌十天半月：形容对用词一丝不苟。

equivalents: agonising over every word
weeks to settle on a single term

examples.zh: 词典编辑部深知一名之立，旬月踟蹰，每个译名都要反复核对。
examples.en: The dictionary team knows that one term can take weeks to settle, and checks every rendering again and again.

examples.zh: 她翻译一本诗集花了三年，真是一名之立，旬月踟蹰。
examples.en: She took three years to translate a poetry collection: truly 'one term, weeks of hesitation'.

story.en: In the same preface to 《天演论》 Yan Fu explains that new Western concepts had no Chinese names, so he had to coin them himself, and 'to fix a single term I hesitate for ten days or a month'.
story.zh: 严复在《天演论·译例言》中说，西方新概念在中文里没有现成名称，需自己创译，“一名之立，旬月踟蹰”。

usage.en: Quoted by translators and editors about careful word choice. The original continues 我罪我知，是存明哲 ('those who blame or understand me, let the wise judge'). 踟蹰 is chí chú.
usage.zh: 翻译者、编辑常引来形容斟酌用词。原文下接“我罪我知，是存明哲”。“踟蹰”读chí chú。

text: 潜龙腾渊，鳞爪飞扬；乳虎啸谷，百兽震惶
pinyin: qián lóng téng yuān, lín zhǎo fēi yáng, rǔ hǔ xiào gǔ, bǎi shòu zhèn huáng
literal: hidden · dragon · leap · abyss, scale · claw · fly · wave, suckling · tiger · roar · valley, hundred · beasts · tremble · fear
natural: a hidden dragon leaps from the deep, scales and claws flying; a young tiger roars in the valley and all the beasts tremble

meaning.en: Two images of young power from 'Young China': a dragon bursting from the abyss and a cub whose roar shakes the whole valley.
meaning.zh: 《少年中国说》中的两组形象：潜龙跃出深渊，鳞爪飞扬；幼虎啸于山谷，百兽震惊，喻少年人的新生力量。

equivalents: young power bursting forth
a young tiger's roar that shakes the forest

examples.zh: 毕业演讲中，他朗诵了“潜龙腾渊，鳞爪飞扬；乳虎啸谷，百兽震惶”。
examples.en: In his graduation speech he recited 'the hidden dragon leaps from the deep; the young tiger roars and all beasts tremble'.

examples.zh: 球队新人表现惊艳，真有潜龙腾渊，鳞爪飞扬；乳虎啸谷，百兽震惶的气势。
examples.en: The rookies played brilliantly, with the force of 'the dragon leaping from the deep, the cub whose roar scares the beasts'.

story.en: Liang Qichao (1873-1929) wrote 'Young China' in 1900 while in exile in Japan, calling for a young, vigorous China in place of the 'old empire'.
story.zh: 梁启超（1873—1929）1900年流亡日本时写成《少年中国说》，呼唤以朝气蓬勃的少年中国取代“老大帝国”。

usage.en: Part of the series of images in 'Young China' that begins 红日初升，其道大光 (a separate entry). Often recited at youth events. 乳虎 'cub'.
usage.zh: 出自《少年中国说》一连串意象，开头是“红日初升，其道大光”（另有词条）。常在青年活动中朗诵。“乳虎”指幼虎。

text: 天戴其苍，地履其黄；纵有千古，横有八荒；前途似海，来日方长
pinyin: tiān dài qí cāng, dì lǚ qí huáng, zòng yǒu qiān gǔ, héng yǒu bā huāng, qián tú sì hǎi, lái rì fāng cháng
literal: sky · wears · its · blue, earth · treads · its · yellow, lengthwise · has · a thousand · ages, breadthwise · has · eight · wildernesses, road ahead · like · sea, coming · days · yet · long
natural: the sky wears its blue and the earth treads its yellow; ahead lie a thousand ages and all around the eight corners of the world; the road ahead is wide as the sea and the days to come are long

meaning.en: The closing lines of 'Young China': the young have heaven and earth, all of history and all the world before them, and a long, sea-wide future.
meaning.zh: 《少年中国说》结尾：少年人头顶苍天，脚踏黄土，纵贯千古，横览八荒，前程似海，来日方长。

equivalents: the whole world and a long future lie before you
the road ahead is wide and the future is long

examples.zh: 校长在开学典礼上念起“天戴其苍，地履其黄；纵有千古，横有八荒；前途似海，来日方长”。
examples.en: At the opening ceremony the head read out 'the sky wears its blue, the earth its yellow ... the road ahead is sea-wide and the days to come are long'.

examples.zh: 天戴其苍，地履其黄；纵有千古，横有八荒；前途似海，来日方长，这是送给毕业生的祝愿。
examples.en: 'The sky wears its blue, the earth its yellow; ... the road ahead is sea-wide and the days to come are long': this is the wish for the graduates.

story.en: The final passage of Liang Qichao's essay 'Young China' (1900), after the images of the rising sun, the dragon and the tiger.
story.zh: 梁启超《少年中国说》（1900年）的结尾段落，接在红日、潜龙、乳虎等一连串意象之后。

usage.en: Often quoted at graduations and youth events; the last four characters 前途似海，来日方长 are the best known and are quoted alone. 来日方长 is also a separate entry.
usage.zh: 常在毕业典礼、青年活动上引用；最后八字“前途似海，来日方长”最为人熟知，也常单独引用。“来日方长”另有词条。

text: 二十四史非史也，二十四姓之家谱也
pinyin: èr shí sì shǐ fēi shǐ yě, èr shí sì xìng zhī jiā pǔ yě
literal: twenty-four · histories · not · history · indeed, twenty-four · surnames · 's · genealogy · indeed
natural: the Twenty-Four Histories are not history; they are the family registers of twenty-four ruling houses

meaning.en: A sharp judgement on traditional Chinese historiography: the dynastic histories record rulers and their families, not the nation or its people.
meaning.zh: 对传统史学的尖锐批评：正史只记帝王将相一家一姓的兴衰，而不是国家和人民的历史。

equivalents: history written as the family record of ruling houses
chronicles of dynasties, not of peoples

examples.zh: 梁启超说“二十四史非史也，二十四姓之家谱也”，主张写民史。
examples.en: Liang Qichao said the Twenty-Four Histories are 'not history but genealogies of twenty-four houses' and called for a history of the people.

examples.zh: 课上讨论了二十四史非史也，二十四姓之家谱也这一说法是否过激。
examples.en: The class discussed whether the claim that the Twenty-Four Histories are only the genealogies of twenty-four houses goes too far.

origin.source: 梁启超《新史学·中国之旧史》（1902年）

story.en: In 'The Old Histories of China', the first chapter of 'New Historiography' (《新史学》, 1902), Liang Qichao attacks traditional histories for knowing only dynasties and not the nation, and quotes this saying.
story.zh: 梁启超在《新史学》（1902年）第一章《中国之旧史》中批评旧史只知有朝廷而不知有国家，并引用此语。

usage.en: In the essay Liang reports it as a saying already in circulation, calling it a little extreme but not far wrong; today it is the usual quotation for the 'new history' movement. 二十四史 is the set of official dynastic histories.
usage.zh: 梁启超在文中将它作为已有的说法引用，称其虽稍过，却也有道理；今天是“新史学”运动的代表性引语。二十四史指历代官修正史。

text: 不有行者，无以图将来；不有死者，无以召后起
pinyin: bù yǒu xíng zhě, wú yǐ tú jiāng lái, bù yǒu sǐ zhě, wú yǐ zhào hòu qǐ
literal: not · have · goer, no · means · plan · future, not · have · dier, no · means · call · later · risers
natural: without those who leave, there is no planning for the future; without those who die, there is no summoning those who will rise after

meaning.en: Tan Sitong's words in 1898: reform needs both those who flee to carry on the work and those who die to rouse others to follow.
meaning.zh: 谭嗣同1898年所言：变法既需要有人出走以图将来，也需要有人牺牲以唤起后来者。

equivalents: some must go on, some must die, to rouse the rest
martyrdom summons those who follow

examples.zh: 纪念馆里展出了“不有行者，无以图将来；不有死者，无以召后起”的手迹。
examples.en: The memorial hall displays the manuscript of 'without those who go, no plan for the future; without those who die, none to rise after'.

examples.zh: 历史课上，老师讲起谭嗣同那句“不有行者，无以图将来；不有死者，无以召后起”。
examples.en: In history class the teacher spoke of Tan Sitong's words 'without those who go ... without those who die ...'.

origin.source: 梁启超《谭嗣同传》引谭语

story.en: Liang Qichao's 'Biography of Tan Sitong' records that after the coup of September 1898 Tan Sitong (1865-1898) refused to flee, telling Liang this, and was executed a few days later with five others.
story.zh: 梁启超《谭嗣同传》记载：1898年政变后，谭嗣同（1865—1898）拒绝出逃，对梁启超说了这番话，数日后与同志五人就义。

usage.en: Quoted in accounts of the 1898 Reform. Liang Qichao records that Tan said it to him when urging him to flee to Japan while he himself stayed to die. Formal, historical.
usage.zh: 常见于戊戌变法的叙述。据梁启超记载，谭嗣同劝他东渡日本，自己则留下赴死时说了这番话。正式，历史引语。

text: 二千年来之政，秦政也，皆大盗也；二千年来之学，荀学也，皆乡愿也
pinyin: èr qiān nián lái zhī zhèng, qín zhèng yě, jiē dà dào yě, èr qiān nián lái zhī xué, xún xué yě, jiē xiāng yuàn yě
literal: two · thousand · years · of · government, Qin · government · is, all · great · robbers · are, two · thousand · years · of · learning, Xun · learning · is, all · hypocrites · are
natural: two thousand years of government have been the government of Qin, the work of great robbers; two thousand years of learning have been the learning of Xunzi, the work of hypocrites

meaning.en: Tan Sitong's radical charge: since the Qin, Chinese rule has been despotic and Confucian scholarship timeserving.
meaning.zh: 谭嗣同的激烈批判：秦以来两千年的政治都是专制的秦政，两千年的学术都是迎合专制的荀学。

equivalents: two thousand years of despotism and sycophantic scholarship
a sweeping indictment of tradition

examples.zh: 谭嗣同在《仁学》中宣称“二千年来之政，秦政也，皆大盗也；二千年来之学，荀学也，皆乡愿也”。
examples.en: In 'A Study of Benevolence' Tan Sitong declared that two thousand years of government were Qin government and of learning Xunzi's learning.

examples.zh: 二千年来之政，秦政也，皆大盗也；二千年来之学，荀学也，皆乡愿也，这样的话在当时无异于惊雷。
examples.en: 'Two thousand years of government have been Qin government ...' was a thunderclap in its day.

story.en: Tan Sitong (1865-1898) wrote 'A Study of Benevolence' (《仁学》) in 1896-97; published after his death, it attacks despotism and rigid Confucian orthodoxy.
story.zh: 谭嗣同（1865—1898）于1896—1897年写成《仁学》，身后刊行，批判专制与僵化的儒学正统。

usage.en: A well-known example of late-Qing radicalism, quoted in history and thought courses. 乡愿 (xiāng yuàn) means a hypocrite who pleases everyone, as in Confucius's 乡愿，德之贼也. Historians regard it as polemic, not a balanced assessment.
usage.zh: 晚清激进思想的典型引语，见于历史与思想史课程。“乡愿”指不分是非、取悦众人的伪善者，孔子有“乡愿，德之贼也”之说。史学界多视其为论战之语，而非持平之论。
